key.name: qt-click-fix
key.summary: Qt apps: type a word once when clicking (older IBus)
key.description: Ubuntu 20.04 and 22.04 only (IBus older than 1.5.27, which cannot report the focused app). When true, IBus never commits the word being typed by itself, so Qt apps (KDE, Telegram, VLC) do not type it twice on a click; in GTK apps and browsers that word is dropped instead if you click away before Space. Ignored on newer IBus, which handles Qt automatically.
